metaTitle: Custom Water Repellent Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom water repellent jackets for your team. Durable, weather-resistant outerwear with your logo. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Water repellent jackets keep your team dry without the bulk of a full raincoat. The DWR finish on styles like the Boulder Thermal Shell sheds light rain and snow while maintaining breathability. Ideal for outdoor crews, event staff, or client gifts that see real weather. Choose from insulated or shell options, and add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom water repellent jackets with embroidered logo on the chest, featuring a DWR finish for weather protection.
